title: Xanthe and the Summit
author: Wendell Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Dravenmoor, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
